'''2007 Worlds Team Micah Wooten DS Imperial Occupation''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Micah Wooten]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Team).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Micah Wooten]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Imperial Occupation / Imperial Control|SE-D-imperialoccupation.gif|label=Imperial Occupation}}
* '''Stage:''' Team
